data_basis: placeholder — commonly-cited PAU (Punjab Agricultural University) Package of Practices figures for irrigated, timely-sown wheat, used as a stand-in default application rate. Not sourced from a specific farmer's actual application record, and not verified against the current-year PAU Package of Practices document — should be confirmed before being presented as an authoritative recommendation.
notes: P_applied_kg_ha is expressed as P2O5 (the form PAU recommendations are conventionally published in), not elemental phosphorus. K_applied_kg_ha is 0 because PAU does not recommend blanket potash application for Punjab wheat — most Punjab soils test sufficient in potassium, and potash is only recommended where a soil test shows deficiency, which this system does not currently collect.
